# HonestFurnace

> HonestFurnace is a free directory of heating and cooling (HVAC) companies that shows who owns each one, private-equity or investor-owned versus independent, with public sources. It starts with Ohio metros and plans to add more states.

## Directory
- [Locally Owned HVAC Companies in Ohio](https://honestfurnace.com/): Homepage with ZIP lookup
- [Ohio HVAC Companies by Metro: Who Owns Them?](https://honestfurnace.com/oh/): Ohio metros and ownership overview
- [Locally Owned HVAC Companies in Columbus, OH](https://honestfurnace.com/oh/columbus/): HVAC companies in the Columbus area and who owns them
- [Locally Owned HVAC Companies in Cleveland, OH](https://honestfurnace.com/oh/cleveland/): HVAC companies in the Cleveland area and who owns them
- [Locally Owned HVAC Companies in Cincinnati, OH](https://honestfurnace.com/oh/cincinnati/): HVAC companies in the Cincinnati area and who owns them
- [Locally Owned HVAC Companies in Dayton, OH](https://honestfurnace.com/oh/dayton/): HVAC companies in the Dayton area and who owns them
- [Locally Owned HVAC Companies in Toledo, OH](https://honestfurnace.com/oh/toledo/): HVAC companies in the Toledo area and who owns them
- [Locally Owned HVAC Companies in Akron-Canton, OH](https://honestfurnace.com/oh/akron-canton/): HVAC companies in the Akron-Canton area and who owns them
- [Locally Owned HVAC Companies in Youngstown, OH](https://honestfurnace.com/oh/youngstown/): HVAC companies in the Youngstown area and who owns them
